request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).

a.quote: When using folder-based discovery in an ESM project with test runners like Vitest, you may encounter an error like `TypeError: Unknown file extension ".ts"` (ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION).

b.quote:
**Folder-based discovery and ESM:**

When using folder-based discovery (glob patterns in `entities` option) in an ESM project with test runners like Vitest, you may encounter an error like `TypeError: Unknown file extension ".ts"` (ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION).

a.quote: This happens because the dynamic import of your entities fails to resolve TypeScript files - MikroORM performs these imports internally, and tools like Vitest cannot automatically transform them.

b.quote:
This happens because the dynamic import of your entities fails to resolve TypeScript files - MikroORM performs these imports internally, and tools like Vitest cannot automatically transform them.

To work around this, you can override the `dynamicImportProvider` option in your ORM config.
